problem: edge-selection QUBO, diamond graph, 5 qubits, QAOA p=1
controlled: identical QUBO, depth, parameters, shots, decoding and objective across all backends
conclusion: Both real QPUs decoded the true optimal path and matched the classical optimum. Feasible sampling rate degraded modestly under hardware noise (19.8% ideal -> 18.7% marrakesh -> 16.1% fez). This validates the encode/submit/decode pipeline on real hardware; it is NOT evidence of quantum advantage, since a classical exact solve returns the same answer instantly.
